# Location manager policy refactor (2026-06-08 10:38Z)

_**User**_

Requested implementation of a modularization plan for the oversized `LocationManager.swift`, followed by changelog update and commit.

---

_**Agent**_

Refactored `LocationManager` into focused internal components while preserving the existing app-facing API and behavior. Extracted tracking policy, Smart frequent runtime policy, location sample policy, background forensics, upload service, metrics store, and heading smoothing into dedicated files under `LocationManagers`.

Split the location-related regression coverage out of `SettingsConfigurationTests` into focused policy suites for tracking, Smart frequent behavior, sample filtering/dedupe, background forensics, and metrics.

Updated `CHANGELOG.md`, `documentation/test-katalog.md`, and `documentation/test-gap-matrix.md` to reflect the refactor and moved tests.

Verified with:

```sh
xcodebuild build -project miataru/miataru.xcodeproj -scheme miataru -destination 'id=9701FE64-5BE0-4377-8E82-14C43F80E6C9'
xcodebuild test -project miataru/miataru.xcodeproj -scheme miataru -destination 'id=9701FE64-5BE0-4377-8E82-14C43F80E6C9' -only-testing:miataruTests
xcodebuild test -project miataru/miataru.xcodeproj -scheme miataru -destination 'id=9701FE64-5BE0-4377-8E82-14C43F80E6C9' -only-testing:miataruUITests/ExtendedUITests/testLaunchWithCompletedOnboardingShowsRootTabs -only-testing:miataruUITests/ExtendedUITests/testSettingsAdvancedOptionsNavigationMovesAdvancedControlsOffRootScreen -only-testing:miataruUITests/ExtendedUITests/testSettingsShowOnboardingActionIsReachable
```

The full scheme test run also executed all 184 unit tests successfully; three UI tests were initially reported as runner `signal kill/term` crashes, then passed when retried directly.
